scope: First F07 soundness reconstruction: finite typed signed CPWA expressions, every accepted native rule and finite acyclic proof; characterize bridge from checked arithmetic to evidence-relative use. No completeness, later gate or training.
reliable: Structural normalization and local-rule proof, explicit source domains and nonvacuity.
exploratory: Where proof-relative source validity, adaptive proof selection and paired expectations permit stronger conclusions without misplaced certainty.
acceptance: Write soundness theorem and complete rule audit for specified fragment, independently reconstruct at least one composition; executable hostile evidence and >=30 observed derivation minutes. F07 stays partial below D90.
